notes: I replaced the v2 dip+bump correction with a smooth monotone transition: the data (E12, E14, E16) show no dip at 0 or bump at -1, but rather a smooth curve where the slope steepens near the origin (~5.2) and relaxes to the far-field slopes (~4.7). I fit gaussian corrections on each side to match the dense near-origin grids while keeping the exact far-field linear law.
